name: Eurojackpot
verdict: A game of Nederlandse Loterij, whose shareholders are the Dutch state (Ministry of Finance), NOC*NSF and Stichting Aanwending Loterijgelden Nederland. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Feyenoord's sleeve partner on the home and away shirts to 2030. Nederlandse Loterij's owners are the Dutch state and two sports bodies (eurojackpot-ownership); a state without a sourced record of abuses is not a tier (METHOD.md), so 'none'. Feyenoord's release says the proceeds of Nederlandse Loterij's games go to Dutch sport.
